scripts.dev:back: cd back && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && pnpm start:dev
scripts.docker:up: cd back && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:down: cd back && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.docker:prod:build: cd back && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build
scripts.docker:prod:up: cd back && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.docker:prod:down: cd back && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
